relationships.subject: green light
relationships.evidence_quote: low-intensity (200 lux) green light treatment exerts antinociceptive effects through a neural circuit from the visual cortex projecting to the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) in mice

key_findings: Low-intensity green light produces antinociception in mice via V2M glutamatergic projections to ACC GABAergic neurons that inhibit local ACC glutamatergic neurons.
Activating the V2M-Glu to ACC GABA-Glu circuit mimics green-light antinociception in neuropathic and inflammatory pain models; inhibiting ACC-projecting V2M neurons abolishes it.
